title: myapp is running fine, just not on the port everyone expects
description_md:
`myapp` is supposed to serve on port 8080, but `curl http://localhost:8080/` gives connection refused. The process is up and healthy -- it's just listening somewhere else. This app doesn't hardcode its port; it looks it up by name from the system's service-name database, and that entry is stale from before a port reassignment. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), find out what port it's actually on and why, and get it onto 8080.

You're done when `curl http://localhost:8080/` succeeds.
